changelog: Settings entry fix: a show-in-settings choice made while CloudStream still used its XML settings list no longer hides the CS3M entry in the new Compose settings screen - the choice now counts per settings UI generation, so the row appears again while an explicit opt-out still wins.
Settings entry robustness: the row is retried briefly while the settings screen lays out and, if it cannot be placed at all, a compact fallback entry is pinned so the entry is never silently missing.
The gear sheet now reports the live state of the settings entry (injected row, pending or off) next to the version, so the behaviour is verifiable at a glance.
The injected settings row now has an opaque themed surface, so the settings list can no longer shine through it.
